description:
You are a clinical nurse specialist on a geriatric ward. Patient Corie Bergnaum (DOB: 1925-02-04, 101-year-old female) has been transferred from a skilled nursing facility for evaluation of functional decline and recurrent falls. Three nursing documentation tasks must be completed during her admission assessment:

1. Record the following vital signs measured on admission: Blood Pressure 162/88 mmHg, Weight 62 kg, Pulse 72 bpm, Temperature 36.8°C. An active visit has been created for this patient.

2. Her neurologist confirmed that Chronic migraine with aura must be added to her active medical problem list as a Confirmed condition — it is currently absent from her OpenMRS chart.

3. The admitting physician has ordered Acetaminophen 500 mg to be added as an active medication for pain and fever management — it is the preferred analgesic for this patient given her age and renal function. Record this medication order.

Complete all three tasks for Corie Bergnaum. Login: admin / Admin123. OpenMRS: http://localhost/openmrs/spa
